description: Stereo equaliser after the Neve 1073: input gain, a fixed high shelf, a switchable mid band, a switchable low shelf and a highpass

params.text: Boosts the signal going into the equaliser, 1x with the knob down to 5x with it up
Boosts or cuts a shelf fixed at 10kHz, -15dB to +15dB
Boosts or cuts the mid band at whatever frequency the mid selector picks, -15dB to +15dB
Picks the centre frequency of the mid band: Off, 360Hz, 700Hz, 1.6kHz, 3.2kHz, 4.8kHz or 7.2kHz; at Off the mid band is skipped, and that is where the knob starts
Boosts or cuts the low shelf at whatever frequency the low selector picks, -15dB to +15dB
Picks the corner of the low shelf: Off, 35Hz, 60Hz, 110Hz or 220Hz; at Off the shelf is skipped, and that is where the knob starts
Picks the highpass corner: Off, 50Hz, 80Hz, 160Hz or 300Hz, applied as three cascaded one-pole stages; at Off the highpass is skipped, and that is where the knob starts
Scales the output after the equaliser, from silence to unity, and starts at a quarter
Passes both inputs straight to the outputs and puts out all the lamps

inputs.text: Left audio in, and the signal used for both channels when the right jack is empty

outputs.text: The left channel after the equaliser, clamped to ±10V
The right channel after the equaliser, clamped to ±10V

notes: three pairs of lamps meter the signal after the input gain, after the equaliser and at the output; each shows green below 5V and red at 5V or above.

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only
